hospitalAnswer:
Facts
Selected map location: North Shore University Hospital (source snapshot: Trauma Centers). Facility footprint remains unverified.
Supplied map geometry intersects these NYS administrative boundaries: County: Nassau; Town: North Hempstead. Source: NYS Civil Boundaries (https://gis.ny.gov/civil-boundaries). Full containment, facility ownership and emergency authority are not established.
Regional KB context
Flooding — regional KB: AE examples include Freeport waterfront and Massapequa bay-front; VE examples include Fire Island and Jones Beach Island. These are regional examples, not a site-specific zone assignment. Source: Flood Zones [FEMA / Local].
Evacuation — regional KB: Nassau shelter references include Nassau Community College (Garden City), Kellenberg Memorial HS (Uniondale) and Carey HS (Franklin Square). South-shore mainland route references include Southern State Pkwy / Sunrise Hwy. Shelter opening, road availability and the selected location’s evacuation-zone membership are not established by these listings. Source: Evacuation Zones [Local OEM].
Critical facilities — regional KB examples: Nassau University Medical Center (East Meadow), North Shore University Hospital (Manhasset), Good Samaritan University Hospital (West Islip) and Stony Brook University Hospital. This is not a nearest-facility ranking or confirmation of current capacity, access or operating status. Source: Critical Infrastructure [Local OEM].
Coordination — regional KB contacts: Nassau OEM 516-573-9600; Suffolk OEM 631-852-4900. Their listing does not establish command assignment or authority for the selected facility. Source: Contacts & Resources [Local OEM].
Gaps
The regional KB listings do not establish the selected location’s flood or evacuation zone, an active evacuation order, open shelters or available medical capacity. Site mapping and current local-source status are needed for those determinations.
